Package aor.proj3t.daos.interfaces

Interface SettingsDAO

All Superinterfaces:
BasicDAO<Settings,Long>
All Known Implementing Classes:
SettingsDAOimpl
public interface SettingsDAO extends BasicDAO<Settings,Long>
Data Access Object interface for Settings entity operations.

This interface extends BasicDAO to provide operations for managing application-wide configuration settings. Settings entities store system configuration parameters that control application behavior and can be modified at runtime without code changes.

Key features include:

  • Retrieving current/latest application settings
  • Configuration versioning support
  • Runtime configuration management
  • System parameter storage and retrieval

  • Method Details

    • getLatestSettings

      Optional<Settings> getLatestSettings()
      Retrieves the most recent settings configuration.

      This method returns the latest version of application settings, which represents the current active configuration. If multiple settings records exist (for versioning purposes), this method returns the most recently created or updated one.

      Returns:
      An Optional containing the latest settings if found, or Optional.empty() if no settings exist in the system
